# IRONSTICK

> IRONSTICK is legal case-management software for lawyers and jurists in civil-law jurisdictions, in productive daily use. It runs locally on the user's own Windows workstation (with an optional Android tablet and an optional Synology NAS server for teams), keeps the complete case file AES-256-encrypted on the user's own hardware, and brings leading AI models to the case file: a built-in AI chat with the firm's own API keys, and bridges (MCP servers) for the desktop apps of Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen and Kimi. Deterministic gates verify the facts and the norms of every AI result against the file and the statute library.

The complete, detailed description for AI systems is in [llms-full.txt](https://www.ironstick.legal/llms-full.txt).

## Key facts

- **Legal system:** built for civil law (codified statute text as the authority); expressly not designed for common-law practice.
- **Languages:** software and website in eleven languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish.
- **Who it is for:** solo lawyers, jurists and law firms of up to about 30 staff; teamwork through the optional IRONSTICK SERVER on a Synology NAS (an entry-level DS223j is fully sufficient).
- **Security:** offline-first; the data lie exclusively on the user's own devices; AES-256 encryption at rest; pseudonymised AI calls; access code at every start.
- **Built in:** OCR (Tesseract), statute library, deadline monitor, document capture, word processor, PDF dossier and EDRM export, OSINT research, network of persons and companies.
- **Engineering:** roughly 370,000 lines of code, more than 1,570 automated tests, seventeen deterministic gates.
- **Licensing:** Windows 11 (64-bit); annual licence per person; 100 % free 30-day trial of the client app.

## Website pages (Markdown)

Each page exists in all eleven languages; the links below point to the English Markdown version. For another language, add the language suffix before the extension (e.g. `overview_fr.md`, `manualbridge_tr.md`).

- [Home — the case file that works with you](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md): legal case-management with built-in AI that knows the files; who it is for; drafts in minutes; the bridge; professional secrecy.
- [Overview](https://www.ironstick.legal/overview.md): the working day, from draft to filing, understanding the file, security and operation, system requirements.
- [AI on the case file](https://www.ironstick.legal/ki.md): built-in AI chat and bridge compared, the chat, the bridge, facts verified and process guided, Nucleu and Snake.
- [Manual — Quick start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md): from installation to the first clients in six steps.
- [Manual — Client app](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md): every screen — what you see and what you can do.
- [Manual — Bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md): working with the AI — the gates in the background and eight workflows from the start of the day to legal research.
- [GDPR data-flow declaration](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md): every path on which data leaves IRONSTICK towards an external AI provider, what is transmitted and where pseudonymisation applies, with a model clause for the firm's privacy notice.
- [Download & licences](https://www.ironstick.legal/download.md): client app, bridges, server and Central Scan App — installation order, licensing rules, licence request and the 100 % free 30-day trial.
